contract: Compare FFmpeg format-open and terminal return codes, stream codec, time base and private data, then packet ordinal, position, PTS, DTS, duration, flags, payload and ordered side data. The candidate uses document snapshots or demuxed sample snapshots from the carriage session. For ISO BMFF, it adds the sample offset and sync flag and compares the tx3g description after the SampleEntry base fields.
